api_library: Project Zomboid vanilla Lua/exposed engine APIs
signature: ISComboBox:new(x, y, width, height, target, onChange, arg1, arg2); onChange(target, combo, arg1, arg2)
returns: Constructor returns a Lua UI object with options/selected fields. Selection callbacks receive target then combo before the two saved arguments. Native pixels and focus acceptance NOT TESTED.
mutation: Client presentation and local control state only. No world, network or save mutation. Shared gameplay must use a consumer server service.

evidence.statement: Vanilla combo selection invokes the saved onChange with target, combo and saved arguments.
Vanilla constructor stores target/onChange/onChangeArgs and initializes local control state.

notes: Source observation supports the public UI.combo wrapper callback shape. Text-entry and scrolling-list constructors reuse the existing native Lua routes; no custom Java/UI class is created. Offline consumer tests are not native rendering or dedicated acceptance.
